text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Tuesday instructed Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui to look at incentives for investment in tourism in the non-coastal regions.
- President Ben Ali on Tuesday recommends Communications Minister Ahmed Friaa to actualize telecommunication legislation in order to modernize the sector.
- First lady Leila Ben Ali on Tuesday received a delegation of American senators' wives visiting Tunisia.

- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari and Libyan Foreign Liaison and International Cooperation Minister Omar Mustafa al-Montasser held cooperation talks in Tripoli. Libyan Leader Muammar Gaddafi received Zouari on Tuesday.
- Tunisian Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi visited Jordan this week for talks to boost trade.
- Mohamed Ridha Kechrid named chairman of the social security fund Caisse Nationale de Securite Sociale (CNSS).
- Tunisia looking at new opportunities for exports.
- New Moslem calendar year Ras el-Am el-Hejri set for Thursday.
- 530 million for investment in the southern city of Sfax in industry and services sectors since 1987.
